plain_description.what: Asks whether a first-level split of the MMLU-Pro tree certifying 3 out of 4 times comes from the greedy 'take the first number of children that passes' rule or from the data. It rebuilds three trees with a rule that requires a 5% margin above the bar, plus 300-repetition null tests. No calls.
plain_description.why: It checks whether a taxonomy result is an artefact of a construction rule rather than a property of the corpus.
plain_description.information: If the margin rule makes the split certify every time, the old 3/4 was a rule artefact. Result: done. With the 1.05 margin rule the site certifies on all three draws, but the rule is not local: it changes the tree below the site. This was tested for one corpus, one bar and one margin value only. Nothing was promoted, and there was no judging.
